## Problem / Use Case

What problem would this feature solve?

Describe what you are currently unable to do, what is inconvenient, or what could be improved.

For example:

> I need to create a `lektor<T>` to pass to an API function, but there is currently no way to construct one from Lua.

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature or behavior you would like to see added.

If you have a specific API, function, syntax, UI, or implementation in mind, include an example.

```lua
```

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative approaches, workarounds, or existing features you have considered.

If you are currently using a workaround, please describe it and explain why it is insufficient.

## Use case / Example

Provide an example of how this feature would be used in a real KenshiLua script or mod.

This helps demonstrate the intended behavior and determine how the feature should fit into the existing API.

## Additional context

Add any other information that may help explain the request.

Screenshots, mockups, code examples, related issues, documentation, or references to relevant KenshiLib/KenshiLua functionality or those found in other projects can be included here.
